description: propAMM v2 vectors for LadderMath, the Venue quote path and what the SDKs encode, generated by contracts/test/vectors/ladder-reference.mjs. Do not edit.

fields.baseIn: the taker sells base, so the fill walks the bids
fields.exactIn: amount is the input; otherwise it is the output
fields.hot: the pair hot word (HotWord layout); mid, widen, widthScale and depthScale repeat its fields
fields.sizeUnit: base units per shape size step
fields.w0: the walked side's first shape word (levels 1-5)
fields.w1: the walked side's second shape word (levels 6-10); 0 unless level 5 has size
fields.consumed: base the walked side already gave up (the venue's consumed): the walk starts after it
fields.amountIn: taker input when expect is ok, else 0
fields.amountOut: taker output when expect is ok, else 0
fields.baseFilled: base moved on this side when expect is ok; the venue adds it to the side's consumed
fields.splits: one order sent as parts: whole is the vector index of one fill of the total, parts the indices of the parts, each from the consumed the last left
fields.shapeChecks: four shape words (bid w0, bid w1, ask w0, ask w1) and the reason ShapeWord.check returns: 0 valid, 1 reserved bits, 2 non-canonical, 3 spread decreases
fields.hotWords: every HotWord field (flags raw: bit 0 bids off, bit 1 asks off, bit 2 refill bids, bit 3 refill asks, 4-15 reserved), the packed word, the word post stores (refill bits cleared) and whether post accepts it (nonzero mid, no reserved bits); a stored word decodes only with flags 0-3
fields.prices: a price string, whether it is an exact unsigned decimal of at most 18 places whose value is a nonzero uint96 (ok), its value scaled by 1e18 (mid) and its shortest form (canonical)
fields.shapes: two canonical ladders as sizes and spreads per level, and their four shape words
fields.shapeRejects: two ladders a shape builder must refuse, with the first broken rule (bids first, level by level): TooManyLevels, ZeroSize or SpreadDecreases
fields.posts: an order or cancel batch (requests omit fields that take the defaults: no widen, both scales 1000, both sides, no refill; a cancel posts both sides off, depthScale 0, validUntil 0, shape 0), expect ok or the first refusal (EmptyBatch, then per request DuplicatePair, InvalidExpiry, InvalidSequence), the post bytes (packed), the post(bytes) calldata and each entry's [pairIndex, sequence]; posted to pairs just added, stored is the word each pair then holds and refills the refill bits each entry applies (4 bids, 8 asks)
fields.quotes: one pair from addPair through its steps at block time timestamp, with no hook, cap or halt, inventory [base, quote] the venue holds: setShape (shapeId, words), post (word, accepted) or quote and fill (baseIn, exactIn, amount; expect ok or the venue error, with args as strings and the token named base or quote; amountIn, amountOut, baseFilled), each with consumed [bids, asks] and inventory [base, quote] after it (only an ok fill moves them). Every step has every field; an op leaves the ones it does not use zero or empty
fields.outcomes: one transaction's post calls in order (calls, each an orders or cancels batch in the posts section's request form), sent to pairs just added (each stores seq 1): posted is the Posted events the venue emits, [pairIndex, stored word] in order, and outcomes each call's entries as [pairIndex, sequence] in request order, split into accepted (stored, an event) and skipped (stale: the pair already stored that sequence or a higher one, earlier in the transaction)
